# Radu Herinean

> I build AI systems and then have to live with them.

The platform was designed and built with Claude Code from a written spec. Every piece is drafted with AI, then edited and signed off by me; before the first piece is published, a second pass checks its technical claims against the code and the commits. The judgment and the mistakes are mine.
